allocation_validation.command:
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
from benchmarks.e_means.memory import MemorySampler
child_code='''import mmap

def allocate(n):
    buf=mmap.mmap(-1,n,flags=mmap.MAP_PRIVATE)
    for i in range(0,n,4096):buf[i]=1
    return buf
warm=allocate(128<<20)
warm.close()
print("FIT_READY",flush=True)
assert input()=="GO"
buf=allocate(32<<20)
print("ALLOCATED",flush=True)
assert input()=="RELEASE"
buf.close()
print("FIT_DONE",flush=True)
assert input()=="STOP_ACK"
'''
p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c',child_code],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
try:
    assert p.stdout.readline().strip()=='FIT_READY'
    sampler=MemorySampler(p.pid,interval_seconds=.01,keep_samples=True).start()
    p.stdin.write('GO\n');p.stdin.flush()
    assert p.stdout.readline().strip()=='ALLOCATED'
    time.sleep(.08)
    p.stdin.write('RELEASE\n');p.stdin.flush()
    assert p.stdout.readline().strip()=='FIT_DONE'
    result=sampler.stop()
    assert result['complete'],result
    assert result['physical_footprint_peak_increase_bytes'] >= int((32<<20)*.9),result
    assert result['lifetime_peak_physical_footprint_bytes'] > result['peak_physical_footprint_bytes']+(64<<20),result
    assert result['peak_physical_footprint_bytes'] > result['end']['physical_footprint_bytes']+(16<<20),result
    assert result['peak_rss_bytes'] > result['end']['rss_bytes']+(16<<20),result
    Path('tmp/e_means/memory-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps({'test':'128MiB warmup unmapped,32MiB fit transient unmapped beforeFITDONE','result':result},indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in {'samples','baseline','end','notes'}}))
    print('baseline_footprint',result['baseline']['physical_footprint_bytes'],'end_footprint',result['end']['physical_footprint_bytes'])
    p.stdin.write('STOP_ACK\n');p.stdin.flush()
    assert p.wait(timeout=5)==0
finally:
    if p.poll() is None:p.kill();p.wait()

allocation_validation.test: 128MiB warmup unmapped,32MiB fit transient unmapped beforeFITDONE

notes: Phase peaks are maxima of current-memory samples, not lifetime maxima.
Sampling can miss transients shorter than the observed sampling gaps.
Phase totals include memory allocated before FIT_READY; increments subtract that baseline.
RSS and physical footprint are different process metrics and must not be added.
Process footprint is not an exclusive GPU-memory measurement.
Lifetime peak is diagnostic only and includes preparation/warm-up.

scope: Actual isolated CPU process, no GPU or datasets; raw observations copied unchanged from tmp/e_means/memory-validation.json.

coverage: fit-window peaks separate from lifetime warmup peak
PID reuse rejected without peak contamination
process exit never synthesized as zero memory
V4 to V0 fallback exposes missing lifetime peak as null
permission error does not trigger flavor fallback
